integrity: The proof is structural. A standalone exact verifier checks finite truncations over Z/4Z and F_2 x F_2 as corroboration only.
scientific_limitations: The exact transfer is proved under the hypothesis 2 not in U(R).
The base ring is assumed finite; no general infinite-cardinal extension is claimed.
When 2 is a unit, constant-term fibers need not be independent and a different loop-sensitive parameter is required.
title: Power-series unit graphs convert total domination into ordinary domination
